challenge.better_approach: A scratch table set for nodes and embeddings: set aside, as in 784eb1e92866, because it stops the proof measuring the live schema. Changing scratch_nexus to forget its leaf at exit would fix every caller at once but reaches into the librarian's tool from codemother's ticket (Rule 1); recorded as the larger alternative, not taken here.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That forget_leaf's delete of a shared node cannot remove a node another, real, writer also deposited: content carries the run's nexus suffix and, after D1, its run id, so a proof node's id is its own.

answers.traces_to: Law 3 and Law 9: a proof's residue in the live corpus is read as real measurement, and a proof that leaves it has not earned clean green.
